dedupe_keys.name: luxembourg contern on demand service data

description: The University of Luxembourg and Sales Lentz publish operating data for an on-demand service in Contern. Temporal coverage runs from March 2025 through April 2026. The dataset combines bus trajectory information, vehicle kilometres travelled, arrival times and customer-request information. Request fields include booking time, the transport mode used to reach or leave Contern station, and pickup and drop-off places and times. These observations describe transport demand and service operation for network-flow and capacity modelling. Zenodo supplies one ZIP archive freely under CC BY 4.0 through the ACUMEN collection. A limitation is that the metadata does not specify internal file formats, sampling steps, record counts or whether any fields were aggregated or anonymised. No passenger or journey records were read. The separate Contern fixed-route shuttle deposit remains an unresolved related lead; its empty description does not establish that the two resources share data.
